screens.title: Systems Developer Portfolio Header - Segmented Locale Switcher (Baseline)
screens.prompt: High-precision systems developer portfolio website header with a compact segmented Locale Switcher pill (EN | FA) co-located in the right utility cluster alongside a theme toggle button. Void black background (#050505), elevated slate surfaces (#111115), structural borders (#27272A), and electric cyan (#06B6D4) telemetry active accents. Segmented pill button showing 'EN' and 'FA' with subtle globe icon and native script labels ('English' / 'فارسی'). Left side brand mark 'AMIN JAMALI // SYSTEMS LAB'. Clean Geist Sans and JetBrains Mono typography.

screens.title: Systems Portfolio Header - Inline Capsule Locale Switcher (Variant 1)
screens.prompt: Monolithic inline telemetry capsule layout. Restructure the locale switcher layout into a unified inline capsule with an integrated live radar/status pulse alongside the globe icon, followed by an inline sliding indicator segment for 'EN · English' and 'FA · فارسی'.

screens.title: Systems Portfolio Header - Micro-Docked Locale Switcher (Variant 2)
screens.prompt: Ultra-compact integrated telemetry layout. Restructure the segmented pill into a micro-docked monospace cluster: Place the micro-globe icon inside an enclosed mini-badge/icon tab on the left, with tight segmented buttons 'EN' and 'FA' (compact uppercase pills) where the active locale 'EN' features a sleek glowing electric cyan border.
